valuation.method: Forward operating EPS x P/E, per Class B share (USD, no ADR conversion). EPS is FY2027 operating earnings (excl. investment gains/losses) divided by Class B-equivalent shares (Class A = 1,500 Class B), viewed at the Nov-2027 target date. Q3 2026 operating earnings $12.705bn on ~1,426,372 average equivalent Class A shares (~2.14bn B-equivalent) = ~$5.94 per B share (my arithmetic; Berkshire reports operating EPS per Class A, ~$8,907). Nine-month 2026 operating earnings ~$37bn (+8%), annualised ~$49bn = ~$23/B share. FY2027 operating earnings and share counts are my assumptions, not company guidance. Operating-earnings multiple is applied to the whole company; ~$377bn of cash/T-bills is embedded in the multiple rather than added separately.

bear.driver: Insurance underwriting stays weak (Q3 underwriting -43% y/y) with a catastrophe-heavy year, lower T-bill yields cut investment income, and BNSF/manufacturing flat.
bear.assumption: FY2027 operating earnings $46.0bn / 2.12bn B-equivalent shares = EPS $21.70 at 21x

base.driver: Underwriting normalises, BNSF and manufacturing grow mid-single digits, buybacks (~$14.4bn in 9M 2026) trim the share count about 2%, T-bill income softens modestly.
base.assumption: FY2027 operating earnings $52.0bn / 2.10bn B-equivalent shares = EPS $24.76 at 24x

bull.driver: Underwriting rebounds to a strong combined ratio, higher investment income on the cash pile, deployment of cash into acquisitions or accelerated buybacks.
bull.assumption: FY2027 operating earnings $57.0bn / 2.08bn B-equivalent shares = EPS $27.40 at 26x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $24.76 the $592.94 close implies 23.9x; the only 12-month-labelled-style call found (UBS $628) implies 25.4x base EPS, or EPS $26.17 at the base 24x. The weighted analyst target is not computed because no target has a documented 12-month horizon.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $24.76 (4.2 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly insurance underwriting pre-tax earnings (Q3 2026: $1.35bn vs $2.37bn a year earlier) and the buyback pace.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 results and 2026 annual report/10-K, expected around late February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Only two named analysts with dated calls were found, both before the Nov 7 earnings release, so none reflects Q3 results. UBS (Meredith, Buy) raised to $628 from $604 on Oct 22; DBS (Manyi Lu, Hold) had $540 in August. UBS $628 equals about 25.4x base EPS, about 1.4 turns or 5.7% above the base target; the multiple versus EPS split is not known. DA Davidson ($592, Buy, Aug 11) was reported by an aggregator without a named analyst and is excluded. No target horizon is documented, so none enters the weighted target.
